abstract: STUDY DESIGN: A case report of cauda equina syndrome (CES) in an 11-month-old infant, following sacrococcygeal teratoma tumor resection and coccyx excision leading to a spinal epidural hematoma (SEH). OBJECTIVE: To illustrate a rare case of CES and SEH in an infant, and discuss the need for sealing access to the spinal canal after sacrococcygeal surgical resection and reconstruction. SUMMARY OF BACKGROUND DATA: To the authors' knowledge, this is the youngest patient reported to develop a SEH and CES, and the only patient reported in the literature to develop a SEH after coccyx excision. METHODS: Seventeen days after undergoing sacrococcygeal tumor resection and coccyx excision, the patient presented to the emergency room with a large distended bladder, loss of rectal tone, and significant weakness in the lower extremities. Magnetic resonance imaging of the thoracic and lumbar spine showed a large lesion in the dorsal epidural space extending from T12 to the tip of the communicating with the prior operative site by means of the previous coccyx resection. The infant was emergently brought to the operating room for decompression. RESULTS: The patient was discharged 6 days later with diminished neurologic function, but demonstrated significant improvement over the next 18 months and currently remains disease free and neurologically normal at age 7. CONCLUSION: This case demonstrates the need for future examination of sacrococcygeal surgical resection and subsequent reconstruction of excised structures to decrease the risk of communication with the epidural space.
abstract_ja: 研究デザイン: 症例報告。目的: 仙尾部奇形腫の外科的切除および尾骨切除の後に、乳児に馬尾症候群と硬膜外血腫が生じた稀な症例を示し、仙尾部手術後の再建において脊柱管への通路を封鎖する必要性を検討する。背景データの要約: 知る限り、これは硬膜外血腫と馬尾症候群を発症した最年少の患者であり、尾骨切除後に硬膜外血腫を生じた文献上唯一の患者である。方法: 仙尾部腫瘍の外科的切除および尾骨切除の17日後、患者は膀胱の著明な拡張、直腸緊張の消失、下肢の著明な筋力低下を呈して救急外来を受診した。胸腰椎のMRIで、T12から仙骨先端に及ぶ背側硬膜外腔の大きな病変を認め、これは尾骨切除を介した従前の手術部位と連続していた。乳児は緊急で減圧術のために手術室へ搬送された。結果: 患者は6日後に神経機能低下を残して退院したが、その後18か月にわたり著明な改善を示した。7歳の時点で病変は再発せず、神経学的にも正常である。結論: 本症例は、仙尾部の外科的切除と、切除した構造の再建後に脊柱管への通路を封鎖し、硬膜外腔との交通のリスクを減らす必要性を示している。
